## Checks
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] New logic has a test (with synthetic data or fake pages/processes, no real captures)
- [ ] No names, handles, channel names, personal paths, cookies, tokens or captured content in code, docs, tests or commits
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs) if behaviour changed
- [ ] For statistics: no look-ahead, costs included, nulls unchanged or improved
